name: Lovable
description: Lovable is an AI software engineer and web-app builder that turns natural-language prompts into websites and web applications. It combines conversational building, visual editing, cloud hosting, authentication and backend services, GitHub sync, integrations, and credit-based AI/application usage inside shared workspaces.
best_for: Founders, product teams, operators, and nontechnical builders who want to create and publish web applications quickly through prompts and visual editing while retaining ownership of generated code.
features: Prompt-based generation and iterative editing of websites and web applications
Visual Edits for directly modifying interface elements without writing prompts
Lovable Cloud for hosting and application infrastructure
Authentication, database/backend workflows, and integrations including GitHub and payment providers
Shared workspaces with unlimited members and pooled workspace credits
GitHub sync so generated code can live in a normal repository
Built-in payments for eligible Pro-or-higher projects using supported payment providers

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Includes daily build-credit grants, capped monthly, plus limited Cloud/AI grants.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Official Lovable guide lists $25/month or $21/month billed annually, with 100 base monthly credits plus daily credits and paid-plan capabilities.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Official Lovable guide lists starting at $50/month or $42/month billed annually, adding team/security controls such as SSO and security-center features.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing with volume-based credits and advanced enterprise controls/support.

pros: Permanent free plan makes it possible to start building before paying
Workspace pricing is credit-based rather than per-seat, and current plans allow unlimited members
Generated projects and code remain owned by the customer and can sync to GitHub
cons: Credit consumption varies by task complexity and feature, making usage cost less predictable than a fixed message quota
Lovable primarily generates web applications rather than native iOS/Android binaries
Apps with significant traffic or AI/cloud usage can consume credits beyond included grants

faq.question: Is Lovable free?
faq.answer: Yes. Lovable has a Free plan with daily build-credit grants and limited monthly Cloud and AI grants. Paid plans add a shared credit balance and additional capabilities.

faq.question: Does Lovable charge per seat?
faq.answer: No. Lovable states that workspaces support unlimited members and plans are priced by included credits rather than number of seats.

alternatives.name: Replit
alternatives.description: Cloud development platform with AI Agent, browser IDE, hosting, and database services.
alternatives.best_for: Builders who want more direct access to code and a full browser IDE alongside AI generation.

alternatives.name: Cursor
alternatives.description: AI-first desktop code editor for professional code-centric development.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who prefer local IDE workflows and granular control over an existing codebase.

alternatives.name: Windsurf (now Devin Desktop)
alternatives.description: AI-native desktop editor transitioning to Devin Desktop with multi-agent management.
alternatives.best_for: Developers wanting a desktop coding environment and agent command center.
